title: Return FileSystem, Calculator and Weather errors to the LLM instead of raising

files.patch:
@@ -10,6 +10,7 @@
 - [SECURITY]: A change which fixes a security vulnerability.
 
 ## [Unreleased]
+- [BUGFIX] [https://github.com/patterns-ai-core/langchainrb/pull/1070] Return a message instead of raising from `Langchain::Tool::FileSystem` (reading a directory, listing a file, writing into a missing directory) and `Langchain::Tool::Calculator` (division by zero), and from `Langchain::Tool::Weather` when the weather request fails after the location lookup, which ended the `Langchain::Assistant` run in `:failed`.
 - [BUGFIX] [https://github.com/patterns-ai-core/langchainrb/pull/1066] Read the fixed output with `#chat_completion` in `Langchain::OutputParsers::OutputFixingParser`; `#completion` is `nil` or not implemented on the Anthropic, Ollama, Mistral AI and Google Gemini chat responses, so fixing never succeeded there.
 - [BUGFIX] [https://github.com/patterns-ai-core/langchainrb/pull/1068] Call the cohere-ruby 1.0 (v2 API) `chat` and `embed` from `Langchain::LLM::Cohere`, which raised `ArgumentError` with the gem version the gemspec requires; v1 `chat_history` messages are converted, and `CohereResponse` reads v2 and v1 bodies.
 - [BUGFIX] [https://github.com/patterns-ai-core/langchainrb/pull/1065] Leave the tools out of the request when the Ollama assistant adapter gets `tool_choice: "none"`, and stop logging `tool_choice`/`parallel_tool_calls` warnings on every call for the Assistant's defaults.

@@ -27,19 +27,27 @@ def list_directory(directory_path:)
       tool_response(content: Dir.entries(directory_path))
     rescue Errno::ENOENT
       tool_response(content: "No such directory: #{directory_path}")
+    rescue Errno::ENOTDIR
+      tool_response(content: "Not a directory: #{directory_path}")
     end
 
     def read_file(file_path:)
       tool_response(content: File.read(file_path))
     rescue Errno::ENOENT
       tool_response(content: "No such file: #{file_path}")
+    rescue Errno::EISDIR
+      tool_response(content: "Is a directory, not a file: #{file_path}")
     end
 
     def write_to_file(file_path:, content:)
       File.write(file_path, content)
       tool_response(content: "File written successfully")
     rescue Errno::EACCES
       tool_response(content: "Permission denied: #{file_path}")
+    rescue Errno::ENOENT
+      tool_response(content: "No such directory: #{File.dirname(file_path)}")
+    rescue Errno::EISDIR
+      tool_response(content: "Is a directory, not a file: #{file_path}")
     end
   end
 end
